parole.testo: Ultimately from Portuguese ananás, in turn from Old Tupi naná (“pineapple”).

Borrowed from Portuguese flamengo (“flamingo”), itself borrowed from Old Occitan flamenc (“flame-like, flamey”), ultimately derived from Latin flamma (“flame”), named after the color of the bird.
